<includeonly>The [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 2|second issue]] of the [[De Agostini]] magazine ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' was set to be published on [[January 9]], [[2002]], according to <small>{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/collecting/story/Star_Wars_Fact_Files_Available_in_UK_69616.asp|text=Star Wars Fact Files Available in UK|author=Thomas|date=27-12-2001|archivedate=20220604071457}}</small>. Additionally, the series announcement on {{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20010317.html|text=First Look: DeAgostini ''Star Wars'' Fact Files}} states that the magazine was to be published weekly. {{#ifeq:{{{1|}}}|2||&#32;Therefore, it can be calculated that [[The Official Star Wars Fact File {{{1}}}|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' {{{1}}}]] was published around {{#switch:{{{1|}}}

==Usage==
Copy-paste the following code and replace "NUMBER" with the appropriate issue number.
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>FFdates|''NUMBER''}}

===Example===
 <nowiki>{{FFdates|19}}</nowiki>
*{{FFdates|19}}
